name: How long does a kitchen lighting upgrade take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen lighting upgrade take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen lighting upgrade depends on the project's scope. A straightforward fixture replacement might take a day or two. However, a more comprehensive upgrade involving new wiring, recessed lighting installation, or significant electrical panel work could extend to several days or even a week. During our consultation, we provide a projected timeline based on the complexity of your specific upgrade. We aim to complete projects efficiently while maintaining quality workmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies; simple upgrades take 1-2 days, while complex electrical work can extend to several days or a week.
